# Evercraft AI Boardroom | Standard
Independent Evercraft commercial product | part of the Evercraft OS portfolio.
Customer page: https://jgaethle10.github.io/forge-operator/mesh/checkout-ready/ai-boardroom-standard/
Product definition: https://jgaethle10.github.io/forge-operator/mesh/checkout-ready/ai-boardroom-standard/product.json
Exact Stripe SKU: AI Boardroom · Standard Review
Price: USD 250 (one-time scoped service)
Ideal buyer: Founders and managers facing one defined, non-emergency business decision
Problem: A decision matters and the alternatives, evidence gaps and assumptions are poorly understood.
Promise: One decision. Better questions. Clearer tradeoffs.
Scoped deliverable: A written decision brief comparing agreed alternatives, assumptions, risks and open evidence questions
Required buyer inputs: Decision question, available non-sensitive facts, candidate options and existing analyses if any
Agreement needed: One decision, named alternatives, source boundaries, expected length and agreed review deadline
Not included: No live multi-model debate guarantee, board appointment, legal advice or guaranteed outcome
Intent match examples:
- AI second opinion on business decision
- compare conflicting AI business advice
- decision review for a founder

Evercraft Payments is the canonical order-authority target; Systemia Stripe handles the existing exact-product checkout at https://buy.stripe.com/14AdRaaYC68lcDO0E44AU08. Scope, capacity and timeline must be agreed before payment. Provider-paid receipts are reconciled manually. The public product and its checkout are not proof of a completed sale, automated fulfillment or production integration with Evercraft OS.
